defaults.sourceDependencies: W02-W05 accepted foundations; W05-H accepted unlocks W06-00
defaults.mission: ContextQuery, bounded source adapters, retrieval/ranking/trust/freshness, MinimalContextPackage, snapshots/invalidation, explicit memory boundaries, semantic cache and reversible safe speculation with zero authority elevation.
sources: TOCA audited Asset Intelligence/Creative Truth patterns as semantic reference only

tasks.title: W06-00 Coordination / Context Boundary Freeze
actions: Freeze source, trust, freshness, tenant/classification, provenance and conflict boundaries.
Freeze MinimalContextPackage/cache/snapshot non-authority and compatibility rules.
Freeze context-pressure/performance dimensions plus poisoning/staleness threat plan without invented production SLOs.
tasks.forbidden: No runtime feature code, W05 routing, W07 execution, W18 learning or authority semantics.

tasks.title: W06-A ContextQuery + Source Adapters
actions: Define bounded ContextQuery semantics and approved read-only source adapters using W01 context primitives.
Propagate tenant/identity/classification/purpose/consent/jurisdiction constraints and provenance requirements.
Retrieve narrowly by default; never fetch an entire knowledge store merely because selectors are absent.
tasks.forbidden: No provider/business write, retrieval ranking implementation or authority semantics.

tasks.title: W06-E Memory Boundary Model
actions: Define working, episodic, semantic, company, user, temporal, operational and evidence boundaries.
Specify read/write ownership, retention/freshness, tenant/classification and conflict semantics.
Use legacy memory taxonomy only as concept input; no global memory god-store.
tasks.forbidden: No global memory source of truth, direct legacy runtime import or authority semantics.

tasks.title: W06-B Retrieval / Ranking / Trust / Freshness Pipeline
actions: Implement bounded retrieval/ranking with explicit provenance, source trust and task-relative freshness.
Validate conflicts and consent/purpose/jurisdiction constraints where applicable.
Represent stale, unknown and conflicting facts explicitly; trust/ranking never becomes authority.
tasks.forbidden: No stale permissive fallback, authority inference or semantic-cache ownership.

tasks.title: W06-C MinimalContextPackage + Compression
actions: Compile the minimal reproducible context needed by the task from eligible source results.
Track included/rejected source provenance and compression/context-pressure measurements.
Preserve tenant/classification/freshness/conflict/provenance and safety-relevant constraints through compression.
tasks.forbidden: Do not hide policy/authority requirements or material uncertainty through compression.

tasks.title: W06-D ContextSnapshot Compiler + Incremental Invalidation
actions: Define snapshot version/hash/freshness/provenance/source-version and invalidation state.
Support deterministic incremental invalidation/recompilation from W03 events with replay/out-of-order safety.
Snapshot may carry policy references as information but never freezes current execution authority.
tasks.forbidden: No stale snapshot as authority and no duplicate W03 event/replay engine.

tasks.title: W06-F Semantic Cache
actions: Implement cache entries bound to semantic query, tenant/classification, result provenance, TTL/source/config versions and invalidation.
Define hit/miss/stale-rejection semantics and cross-tenant isolation.
Cache accelerates retrieval/reasoning only; never cache credentials, secrets or authority as current permission.
tasks.forbidden: No credential/secret/authority-token caching and no permissive stale hit.

tasks.title: W06-G Safe Speculative Preparation
actions: Implement bounded reversible read-only prefetch/pre-rank/precompute preparation.
Cancel/discard speculative work when source/context/policy compatibility changes.
Prove no W07/provider/device/workflow/local write or authority issuance is reachable.
tasks.forbidden: No external write/executor calls or durable business mutation.

tasks.title: W06-H Context Quality / Performance Tests
actions: Prove equivalent tasks can obtain minimal reproducible context from versioned fixtures.
Exercise stale/poisoned/conflicting sources, cache invalidation and tenant isolation under concurrency.
Measure test-scope package size, retrieval fan-out, cache metrics, invalidation lag, compression and p50/p95/p99 assembly without invented production SLOs.
tasks.ownership: W06 integration/context-quality/performance tests and W06 evidence only
tasks.forbidden: No W18 learning promotion and no new production semantic runtime.
